instruction: Diagnose why the CTA button does not respond and look for console errors.
expected_behaviors: The CTA button should respond to clicks.
The contact form should include name, email, and message fields.
Submitting the contact form should show visible feedback.
The app should not show runtime console errors.
The mobile viewport should not have horizontal overflow.
test_hints: Inspect click handlers and runtime errors.
Check form fields and submit feedback.
Check scrollWidth on a mobile viewport.
